create_abstract_dataclass_subclass: create a subclass of AbstractDataclass with custom fields and initialization logic
create_concrete_dataclass_from_abstract: create a concrete dataclass by inheriting AbstractDataclass without init=False to auto-generate __init__
create_abstract_dataclass_hierarchy: create a multi-level hierarchy of abstract dataclasses inheriting from AbstractDataclass with init=False
review_abstract_dataclass_pattern: review the AbstractDataclass pattern for preventing auto-generated __init__ in abstract dataclass subclasses
refactor_dataclass_to_abstract: refactor an existing dataclass to inherit from AbstractDataclass to enforce custom __init__ in subclasses
